match.q: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
match.answer: Although — followed by a clause (the heavy traffic alone would need despite; here the sentence has a noun phrase, so Despite is also acceptable: Despite the heavy traffic). Best single answer for a clause: if the original read the heavy traffic, choose Despite. → Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.

set.q: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
set.answer: Despite — Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time. Despite is followed by the noun phrase the heavy traffic; although would need a clause such as although the traffic was heavy.
